text:
alice (support): quick escalation — AcmeCorp reports missing audit events in their SIEM after last night's HSM key rotation. They say ~6 hours of events for tenant `acme-usa` never landed in Splunk. Repro steps they gave below. @samir (security-oncall) @jun (eng-infra) :eyes:

ingest-bot: error: decrypt failed for batch s3://audit-exports/acme-usa/2026-03-15/shard-12/part-0003.gz -- HSM_DECRYPT_ERROR code=0x5b
ingest-bot: warning: manifest manifest-20260315-12.json checksum mismatch (expected a2f3..., got 0000...)

alice (support): customer repro steps:
1) They queried Splunk for tenant=acme-usa between 2026-03-15T01:00Z..07:00Z and saw no events.
2) Our export tool listed 24 batch objects for that window. 18 succeeded, 6 show size 0 or decrypt errors.
3) They attempted replay via console -> forwarder -> replay but got "manifest validation failed".

jun (eng-infra): can you paste the manifest path and one failing object key? also which HSM alias was rotated? we rotated alias `alias/redwood-audit-prod` at 2026-03-15T00:45Z but need to confirm if the forwarder had the updated wrapping key id.

alice (support): manifest: s3://audit-exports/acme-usa/manifests/manifest-20260315-12.json
failing objects (examples):
- s3://audit-exports/acme-usa/2026-03-15/shard-12/part-0003.gz (0 bytes / decrypt error)
- s3://audit-exports/acme-usa/2026-03-15/shard-12/part-0005.gz (gzip: unexpected EOF)

samir (security-oncall): thanks. most likely cause is a short rekey race: exporter wrote manifests referencing newly wrapped envelopes while some existing batches were still encrypted with the previous wrapping material and the export manifest got rewritten. two paths: non-destructive replay (rehydrate with old wrapping key) or backfill by re-encrypting existing objects with current key. need the KMS/HSM log for the rotate (audit id) and the envelope key ids in the manifest.

jun (eng-infra): quick diagnostic you can run (internal tool):
```
# fetch manifest and inspect envelope ids
aws s3 cp s3://audit-exports/acme-usa/manifests/manifest-20260315-12.json - | jq '.entries[] | {key: .object_key, envelope_kid: .envelope.kid}'
```
If you see mixed `envelope_kid` values (e.g. kid: abc123 and kid: rotated-456), that's the rekey signature. If so, we can attempt a targeted re-encrypt of the few objects.

alice (support): ran the jq command for them, pasted output (sample):
```
{"key":"2026-03-15/shard-12/part-0003.gz","envelope_kid":"abc123"}
{"key":"2026-03-15/shard-12/part-0005.gz","envelope_kid":"rotated-456"}
{"key":"2026-03-15/shard-12/part-0006.gz","envelope_kid":"rotated-456"}
```
So there are mixed kids. customer confirmed rotate happened ~00:45Z.

samir (security-oncall): OK — plan:
- short term: run a targeted re-encrypt job that uses the old KMS wrapping key via HSM (we still have the old key material accessible for a 7-day window). This will produce new objects wrapped with the current alias so forwarder can validate
- medium term: implement extra manifest atomicity checks to avoid rewriting manifests with mixed envelope ids (tracked ticket #S-xxxx)

jun (eng-infra): I can run the re-encrypt job if we get stakeholder approval. Command (dry-run mode):
```
audit-export-tool reencrypt --manifest s3://audit-exports/acme-usa/manifests/manifest-20260315-12.json \
  --source-kid abc123 --target-alias alias/redwood-audit-prod --dry-run
```
If dry-run looks good, remove --dry-run to actually rewrite objects. We will stream to a temp prefix and then update manifest atomically.

alice (support): customer okayed a maintenance window tonight 02:00-03:00Z. they want a replay after reencrypt. also asked about retention impact — events are within retention (30 days) but they flagged compliance urgency.

samir (security-oncall): good. two security notes: 1) log the re-encrypt operation in the audit trail with request IDs. 2) if any objects are zero-byte we should attempt a rehydrate from source SQS or app logs before re-encrypt (zero-byte usually indicates upstream write failure).

jun (eng-infra): I will schedule the re-encrypt in the window and run the dry-run now. tagging @oncall for supervision. :warning:

alice (support): thanks team — I'll update the customer and attach the manifest + output. I'll follow up in this thread after the dry-run. :thumbsup:
